content: To live is the rarest thing in the world. Most people exist, that is all.
author: Oscar Wilde
sourceWork: The Soul of Man under Socialism (1891)
story: Published in the Fortnightly Review, Wilde's visionary essay explored human freedom beyond industrial monotony. Observing millions of people trapped in repetitive routines solely to survive economic pressures, Wilde lamented that humanity was reducing life to mere biological maintenance. To truly live requires curiosity, art, passion, and deliberate self-realization.
reflectionPrompt: Are your days primarily filled with existing and reacting to demands, or are you carving out intentional space for the things that make you feel truly alive?
